The pedestal and housing are the bulk of the machine; the lens tube is short beside them. Flat mid-grey seamless ground, even neutral grey, no seam, no floor line, a soft shadow under the object. One broad soft source from camera-left and slightly above, no rim light. The object reads matte at its true colour, never cool-shifted by the grey. Real 35mm film capture (Vision3 500T), fine organic grain, softer than digital, NOT digital-clean. OVER-real: chipped blue-green enamel, bare iron, the dull steel lens tube, oil, dust in the rivets.
